findings.detail: The leaf transcribes software-review catalogue entries into a table of tool annotation levels, rather than evaluating confidence for measured compound hits.
The leaf labels software-catalogue tools by their annotation capability, rather than assigning evidence-based confidence levels to experimental suspect hits.
The leaf detects, aligns and quantifies LC-MS features with UmetaFlow, but its procedure and outputs do not include the stage's MS2-spectrum export.
The leaf removes tentative GC-MS identifications and aggregates component areas, rather than consolidating the LC-HRMS suspect-screening evidence required by this stage.
The leaf constructs consensus MS2 spectra and ranks structures with MVP, rather than merging existing suspect hits, rankings and confidence levels into a report.
The leaf collapses redundant putative-annotation rows into a feature table, but does not describe joining suspect matches, structure rankings and identification-confidence evidence.
The leaf filters GC-MS library hits using match factors and database availability, rather than consolidating LC-HRMS suspect annotations, structure ranks and confidence levels.
The leaf flags PFAS suspect-list hits by accurate mass with optional isotope-pattern checks, but does not perform the requested retention-time and MS2-fragment matching.
